prompt:
A 6-year-old in the PICU with respiratory failure is being managed with a conservative oxygenation target.

Based on Oxy-PICU, what did the trial show about 90-day and 1-year mortality when comparing conservative versus liberal oxygenation in critically ill children? Also summarize the trial's health-related quality-of-life, cost-effectiveness, and subgroup findings.

rubric_items.text: States that Oxy-PICU found no statistically significant difference in mortality between conservative and liberal oxygenation at both 90 days and 1 year.
Includes the adjusted hazard ratios with 95% confidence intervals for mortality: 0.75 (0.48-1.17) at 90 days and 0.77 (0.53-1.10) at 1 year.
Notes that health-related quality of life, life-years, and QALYs were similar between strategies, with a 0.001 QALY difference.

Notes the economic findings and subgroup results: a −£879 cost difference, £894 net monetary benefit favoring conservative oxygenation, and no evidence of treatment-effect heterogeneity in the prespecified subgroup analyses.
